The attack highlights the ongoing escalation of aerial assaults on civilian infrastructure across the region. International leaders swiftly condemned the strike as a grave violation of humanitarian norms.

The attack on the rail infrastructure caused significant casualties and highlights ongoing conflicts in the region.

itens.t: Astronomers discover possible new dwarf planet beyond Neptune

itens.d:
Astronomers using the powerful Vera Rubin Observatory have discovered a potential new dwarf planet located in the cold depths of the solar system beyond Neptune. Designated as 2026 ED138, the icy object measures roughly 600 to 1500 kilometers wide and is large enough for its own gravity to shape it into a sphere.

The candidate was found by Matthew Holman of the Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian after running data through a specialized search code on October 13. Confirming it as a dwarf planet would be a major milestone, as scientists have verified only five such bodies to date.

With Booster 22 having also completed its own static fire, the mission remains targeted for November. SpaceX founder Elon Musk noted that the company hopes to attempt catches for both the ship and the Super Heavy booster using the launch tower chopstick arms.

The move aims to anchor market expectations following high market volatility and a dramatic drop on the Brazilian stock exchange.

The IFI projects a primary deficit equivalent to 0.5 percent of the GDP for 2026 and an effective potential primary deficit of 1 percent for 2027. Experts argue that a clear fiscal roadmap and the appointment of a credible finance minister are vital to calming economic agents and investors.

itens.t: US military captures high-resolution photo of China's Shenlong space plane

itens.d:
A U.S. military intelligence agency has published a high-resolution photograph of China's reusable Shenlong space plane captured while docked to another spacecraft in orbit. The image was originally recorded in 2024 by Vantor's WorldView 3 satellite from a distance of 56 miles.

Released as part of a Defense Intelligence Agency report on adversary space threats, the remarkably clear photograph shows the robotic space plane with its payload bay doors open, offering new clues regarding its ongoing orbital missions.

itens.t: Netanyahu falls short of majority in Israeli election

itens.d:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's governing coalition fell short of a parliamentary majority as newly counted ballots revealed a significant surge in support for Arab parties. With the vast majority of votes counted, Netanyahu's bloc is projected to secure 53 seats in the 120-member Knesset.

Meanwhile, the opposition bloc led by Gadi Eisenkot stands at 48 seats, and predominantly Arab parties are projected to win 19 seats. The dramatic increase in Arab voter turnout has left neither major bloc with the 61 seats required to independently form a government, signaling difficult coalition talks ahead.
